name: LHI
recent: Leong Hup 在2026年11月20日公布截至9月30日的季度业绩，营收同比增长11.3%至24.59亿令吉，净利微增0.7%至1.30亿令吉。同期，大股东Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd在11月16日至17日于公开市场增持股份，多名董事的权益申报随之变动。此外，公司一家子公司就MyCC及仲裁庭裁决获得暂缓执行令，等待司法复核。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，营收24.59亿令吉，净利1.30亿令吉。
大股东Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd于11月16日至17日在公开市场增持公司股份。
一家子公司就MyCC及仲裁庭裁决获得暂缓执行令，等待司法复核。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门期内外有多笔权益变动申报，需留意后续持股变化。
子公司涉及MyCC及仲裁庭案件，已获暂缓执行以进行司法复核。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为24.59亿令吉，环比增长11.4%，同比增长11.3%；净利为1.30亿令吉，环比增长27.9%，同比微增0.7%；净利率为5.3%，高于上一季度的4.6%。

recent_en: Leong Hup announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November, with revenue up 11.3% year-on-year to RM2.459 billion and net profit edging up 0.7% to RM130.09 million. Meanwhile, major shareholder Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd acquired shares in the open market on 16-17 November, triggering changes in directors' interest disclosures. In addition, a subsidiary obtained a stay of the MyCC and tribunal decisions pending judicial review.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM2.459 billion and net profit of RM130.09 million.
Major shareholder Emerging Glory Sdn Bhd acquired shares in the open market on 16-17 November.
A subsidiary obtained a stay of the MyCC and tribunal decisions pending judicial review.
risks_en: Multiple changes in directors' and major shareholder's interests were disclosed around the closed period; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
A subsidiary is involved in MyCC and tribunal proceedings and has obtained a stay pending judicial review.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM2.459 billion, up 11.4% QoQ and 11.3% YoY; net profit was RM130.09 million, up 27.9% QoQ and 0.7% YoY; net margin was 5.3%, higher than 4.6% in the previous quarter.
